current_answer: Choose a ready-made frontend skill for a specific task and compatible host, not by its name or popularity. Start with the project’s components, tokens, route, and states when an existing design system governs the work. Treat motion-first instruction packages as conditional: before adopting global smooth scroll or reveals, check stack fit, a reduced-motion route, mobile readability, and a rendered result. Silk Design is a source-inspected candidate, not a seventeenth recommendation. For consequential choices, compare the same project with a careful no-skill brief. None of our sixteen listings has a pool-run outcome comparison.

catalogue_card.question: A motion skill says “never ship static.” Should you use it?
catalogue_card.text: Only if the stack and page need it. Check reduced-motion behavior, mobile readability, and a real render before adopting global scroll effects. Silk Design is not yet one of our sixteen recommendations.

summary: Choose a task-specific skill only when its host and dependencies fit.
For an existing design system, start with real components, tokens, route, and states.
For motion-heavy guidance, check reduced-motion control and mobile readability before making effects the default.
Compare consequential choices with a careful no-skill brief on the same project.
